description: Combined signal patterns with behavior predictions and confidence scores

signal_combinations.name: Play Invitation
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is inviting you (or another dog) to play! The play bow is one of the most reliable and universally understood dog signals — it means 'Everything I do next is just for fun!'

prediction.action: Will likely approach, may bring a toy, bounce around, or do zoomies

signal_combinations.name: Happy Greeting
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is thrilled to see you! The whole-body wiggle and enthusiastic tail wag are signs of pure joy. They might jump up or lean against you for pets.

prediction.action: Will approach enthusiastically, may jump up, lick face, lean against you, or bring a toy

signal_combinations.name: Relaxed & Content
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is feeling calm and content. Their relaxed body language shows they feel safe and comfortable in their environment. A happy dog at peace!

prediction.action: Will likely stay in place, may settle down for a nap, or gently approach for attention

signal_combinations.name: Curious & Investigating
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog has noticed something interesting and is trying to figure it out. Their forward ears and alert stance show focused attention. They're processing information about their environment.

prediction.action: Will likely move toward the object of interest to investigate, may sniff around, tilt head

signal_combinations.name: Alert & Watchful
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog has detected something that has caught their full attention. They're evaluating whether it's a threat or just something interesting. Their body is tense but not aggressive.

prediction.action: May bark to alert, move toward the stimulus to investigate, or look to owner for guidance

signal_combinations.name: Anxious & Uncomfortable
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is feeling anxious and uncomfortable. The low tail, pinned ears, and stress signals like lip-licking show they're not at ease. They need reassurance and possibly distance from whatever is bothering them.

prediction.action: May try to move away, seek comfort from owner, or freeze. If pushed further, may snap defensively

signal_combinations.name: Fearful & Scared
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is genuinely frightened. They're making themselves as small as possible and showing clear fear signals. Please give them space and don't force any interaction. Let them retreat to safety.

prediction.action: Will try to flee or hide. If cornered with no escape, may bite defensively out of fear

signal_combinations.name: Aggressive Warning
signal_combinations.interpretation: ⚠️ WARNING: This dog is displaying clear aggressive signals. They feel threatened and are communicating that they WILL defend themselves. DO NOT approach. Back away slowly without making direct eye contact.

prediction.action: May lunge, snap, or bite if the perceived threat does not retreat immediately

signal_combinations.name: Submissive & Appeasing
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is showing submissive body language. They're trying to communicate that they are not a threat. They may roll over to show their belly as the ultimate sign of deference.

prediction.action: Will avoid confrontation, may roll onto back, lick lips/face, or urinate submissively

signal_combinations.name: Frustrated & Bored
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is bored or frustrated. They want something — attention, food, a walk, or mental stimulation. The insistent barking is their way of saying 'Hey, I need something here!'

prediction.action: May start destructive behavior, continue barking, pace, or bring objects to owner

signal_combinations.name: Protective & Territorial
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog is in protective/territorial mode. They've identified something as a potential intruder and are making it clear this is their territory. They may calm down once the 'threat' is identified as friendly.

prediction.action: Will continue barking, may charge toward the perceived intruder, will position between threat and family

signal_combinations.name: In Pain / Discomfort
signal_combinations.interpretation: This dog appears to be in pain or physical discomfort. They may be guarding a specific body part or showing reluctance to move. A veterinary check-up is recommended.

prediction.action: Will avoid movement, may guard painful area, may snap if pain area is touched

none.description: Safe - dog is friendly or neutral

low.description: Mild caution - dog is uncertain but not threatening

moderate.description: Caution - dog is uncomfortable, approach carefully

high.description: Warning - dog is fearful, may bite defensively

critical.description: Danger - dog is actively threatening, do not approach
